_doc: Symlinked from orchard/dotfiles/claude/settings.json. Read once at session start — changes need a `claude --resume` to apply.
_when_to_add_to_permissions_allow: DO NOT add read-only Bash commands here. The PreToolUse hook at hooks/auto-allow-read-pipelines.py is the home for those — extend its ALLOWLIST set or SUBCMD_READ_OPS dict. Anything the hook auto-allows shadows the equivalent permissions.allow entry (dead code). This array should only contain: (1) tool-level grants like Read / WebSearch / WebFetch that the hook can't express because it only fires for the Bash tool; (2) trusted-but-not-strictly-read-only Bash patterns like `cargo build *` that don't fit the hook's read-only contract.
_evaluation_order: deny -> ask -> hook -> allow -> prompt. permissions.deny is the only true hard block — hooks cannot override it. See hooks/auto-allow-read-pipelines.py header for the full breakdown.
